Tess 问是否来参加培训，Ren 回答 Yes。: Tess asks whether Ren is here for training, and Ren says yes.
这栋楼的服务台: At the help desk in this building
Ren 先确认在这栋楼工作，然后说 help desk。: Ren confirms they work in this building, then says “help desk.”
across the street 指街对面。: “Across the street” means on the other side of the road.
在签到处报名，用自己或虚构的姓名、城市介绍。: Sign in and introduce yourself with a name and city, real or invented.
同伴先问你工作地点，回答之后问回去。: Your partner asks where you work. Answer, then ask them the same question.
你听到的是 station 但不确定。请重说，再确认对方在车站工作。: You think you heard “station.” Ask them to repeat it, then check that they work at the station.
请同伴在同一短句里换三个地点，自己只写下地点，以此检查是否听出了有信息的词。: Have a partner use three different places in the same short sentence. Write down just the places to check whether you caught the words carrying the new information.
说工作地点时，用 at 连接 work 和地点。: Use “at” between “work” and the name of a workplace.
按签到对话的顺序，默练一次介绍、工作、问回去和澄清。: Mentally rehearse the check-in conversation in order: introductions, work, asking back and clarification.
在社区活动报到，问同伴白天在哪儿工作。: At a community event, check in and ask a fellow participant where they work during the day.
培训签到时认识搭档。说明自己在工作还是学习，并记下对方的地点。: Meet your partner at training check-in. Say whether you're working or studying and note their location.
你在南站的咖啡店工作。等 A 主动追问才补充南站，必要时只重说关键信息。: You work at a café at South Station. Mention South Station only if A asks a follow-up question. Repeat just the key information if necessary.
A 完成自我介绍，并确认咖啡店在哪座站。: A introduces themselves and confirms which station the café is in.
独立完成初次见面的交流并核对集合信息: Manage a first meeting on your own and confirm where to meet.
说出姓名和一项工作或学习内容: Give your name and one detail about your work or studies.
围绕对方的回答追问一条信息: Ask a follow-up question about one detail in the other person's answer.
澄清后完整复述集合位置: After clarifying, repeat the full meeting location.
谁在学修自行车？: Who is learning to repair bicycles?
Uma 用 I'm learning 描述自己在学什么。: Uma uses “I'm learning” to describe a skill she's developing.
Leo 说 On Hall Street，回答了店的位置。: Leo answers “On Hall Street” when asked where the shop is.
电梯旁边的侧门: The side door beside the lift
Leo 更正 front door 并给了 by the lift 作为定位。: Leo corrects “front door” and adds “by the lift” to pinpoint the location.
签到时先介绍姓名和一项工作或学习内容。: At check-in, start with your name and one detail about your work or studies.
对方说自己在一家花店工作，打听店在哪里。: Someone says they work at a flower shop. Ask where the shop is.
沿着对方给的信息问: Build your question on the information you've been given.
伙伴说得太快，你只听到 meet。请他重复，再复述他说的集合位置。: Your partner speaks quickly and you only catch “meet.” Ask them to repeat, then say the meeting location back.
again → 地点: Ask again, then repeat the place.
分别读 front door 和 side door，把重心放在第一个词，再请同: Say “front door” and “side door,” stressing the first word. Ask a partner to say one at random and point to the matching door.
I'm 后用 learning，表示目前在学。: Use “learning” after “I'm” for something you're currently studying.
回忆测验里哪一步停顿最长，只重练那一步。: Recall where you paused longest in the test. Practise just that step again.
在新员工参观时确认目的地是西门还是东门。: On a new employee tour, check whether you're going to the west gate or the east gate.
你要参加活动，和陌生搭档交换姓名及工作或学习情况，并弄清在哪里集合。: You're attending an event. Exchange names and work or study details with a new partner and find out where to meet.
你叫 Kit，在街角的面包店工作。活动在二楼接待处集合，接待处在电梯对面。: Your name is Kit. You work at the bakery on the corner. The group meets at the second-floor reception desk opposite the lift.
A 能说明自己做什么，并在结束前准确复述集合楼层和位置。: A explains what they do and accurately repeats the meeting floor and location before finishing.
日常作息、兴趣、喜好与理由: Daily routines, interests, preferences and reasons
和熟人交换日常活动和兴趣，并能说明一个简单理由。: Talk with someone you know about daily activities and interests and give a simple reason.
按时间顺序说出三项日常活动: Describe three daily activities in chronological order.
给出一项活动的准确时间: Give the exact time of one activity.
能说明活动在哪些日子发生: Say which days the activity takes place.
Noah 几点出门？: What time does Noah leave home?
leave home 指离开家，后面是 at eight。: “Leave home” means to go out from home. Here it's followed by “at eight.”
Noah 回答 I have breakfast at work。: Noah replies, “I have breakfast at work.”
Noah 哪些日子通常去散步？: On which days does Noah usually go for a walk?
Only on weekdays 限定了散步的日子。: “Only on weekdays” tells you which days he walks.
说明你八点上班，七点半出门。: Explain that you start work at eight and leave home at seven thirty.
回答下班后通常做什么。: Say what you usually do after work.
对方误以为你每天都早起，说明周末例外。: Someone assumes you get up early every day. Explain that weekends are different.
连读 start at eight，先慢读一遍，再让 at 变短，时间词 eig: Say “start at eight” slowly, then shorten “at” while keeping “eight” clear.
主语是 I 时，walk 用原形。: With “I” as the subject, use the base form “walk.”
不看范例说出早、中、晚各一项活动。: Without looking at the example, name one activity each for morning, afternoon and evening.
对同伴说周六和平日不同的一项活动。: Tell your partner one thing you do differently on Saturdays.
你想约搭档早上一起坐车，核对出门时间和哪些天可行。: You'd like to ride to work together. Check when your partner leaves and which mornings would work.
平日八点十五分出门，周三在家工作，周六九点出门。: You leave home at 8:15 on weekdays, work from home on Wednesdays and leave at nine on Saturdays.
A 记录平日时间，并问出周三的例外。: A notes the usual weekday time and asks about the Wednesday exception.
交换兴趣和参与频率: Discuss interests and how often you pursue them.
用一句话介绍兴趣: Introduce a hobby in one sentence.
说明什么时候或和谁参与: Say when you do it or who joins you.
追问对方兴趣的具体内容: Ask a specific question about the other person's hobby.
Jun 喜欢拍什么？: What does Jun like to photograph?
Jun 用 Old buildings 回答拍摄对象。: Jun answers “Old buildings” when asked what they photograph.
with my cousin 指和表亲一起。: “With my cousin” tells us a cousin comes along.
Ada 有空时做什么？: What does Ada do in her free time?
Ada 说 I draw in my free time。: Ada says, “I draw in my free time.”
说你有空时做陶艺。: Say that you do pottery in your free time.
对方喜欢拍照，问他拍什么。: Your partner likes photography. Ask what they photograph.
对方问你总是一个人徒步吗。告诉他有时和妹妹一起。: Someone asks if you always hike alone. Tell them your younger sister sometimes joins you.
第一个音节读得更长，第二个音节收在 /z/。放进 take photos 再录一: Lengthen the first syllable and end the second with /z/. Record yourself again saying “take photos.”
泛指平时拍照片时，photo 通常用复数 photos。: When talking about photography as a regular activity, use the plural “photos.”
不看文本讲自己的一个兴趣，补充一个时间或伙伴。: Describe a hobby without reading. Add when you do it or who joins you.
听别人说一项兴趣，用一个问题问出细节。: Listen to someone describe a hobby and ask one question about a detail.
你在社区活动遇到搭档，想知道他周末做什么以及去哪里。: At a community event, find out what your partner does on weekends and where they go.
你周六画鸟，地点在运河旁的小桥边。只在被问到地点时说小桥。: On Saturdays you draw birds by the little bridge beside the canal. Mention the bridge only if asked where.
A 能说自己的兴趣，并问出画什么和在哪里画。: A describes their own hobby and finds out what their partner draws and where.
礼貌表达喜好并找到双方都感兴趣的活动: Express preferences politely and find an activity you both enjoy.
用 don't really like 表达一项不太喜欢的活动: Use “don't really like” for an activity you're less keen on.
两人都喜欢哪项活动？: Which activity do they both enjoy?
Lan 喜欢游泳，Ben 也明确说 like swimming too。: Lan likes swimming, and Ben explicitly says “like swimming too.”
谁不太喜欢乒乓球？: Who isn't keen on table tennis?
两人都不太喜欢: Neither of them is keen on it
Lan 说 I don't really like it，it 指乒乓球。: Lan says “I don't really like it.” Here “it” refers to table tennis.
他们准备什么时候去游泳？: When do they plan to swim?
this Friday 和 after work 共同确定时间。: “This Friday” gives the day and “after work” narrows down the time.
同伴邀你打网球，你不太喜欢。说出你喜欢的另一项运动。: Your partner invites you to play tennis. You're not keen on it. Name another sport you enjoy.
听到搭档说喜欢骑车，你也喜欢。说出你们可以去的地方。: Your partner likes cycling and so do you. Suggest somewhere you could go.
同一语速交替说 I like it 和 I don't really like: Alternate between “I like it” and “I don't really like it” at the same speed. Have your partner listen for which activity you like, then check.
这里的主语是 I，否定用 don't like。: With “I” as the subject, use “don't like” for the negative.
对三个不同的活动各说一句真实喜好。: Give your honest opinion of three different activities, one sentence each.
谈午休活动时找到一项双方都喜欢的事。: Find a lunchtime activity you both enjoy.
午休室有跳舞、跑步和乒乓球三项活动，你喜欢乒乓球，不太喜欢跑步。: The break room offers dancing, running and table tennis. You like table tennis and aren't keen on running.
你喜欢跳舞和乒乓球，不太喜欢跑步。A 没问到的活动先别直接说。: You like dancing and table tennis and aren't keen on running. Wait until A asks before mentioning each activity.
找出至少一项双方都喜欢的活动，并口头确认。: Find at least one activity you both enjoy and confirm it aloud.
用 because 给出具体理由，并回应对方的选择: Give a specific reason using “because” and respond to the other person's choice.
Ren 为什么周五走路？: Why does Ren walk on Fridays?
have more time 是 Ren 给出的理由。: Ren gives “have more time” as the reason.
Ren 为什么穿过公园？: Why does Ren walk through the park?
Fay 喜欢走大路的原因是什么？: Why does Fay prefer the main road?
她紧接着说 There's a bakery I like。: She follows up with “There's a bakery I like.”
你喜欢公园，因为那里安静。: You like the park because it's quiet.
对方每次都坐地铁，问问原因。: The other person always takes the subway. Ask why.
对方喜欢去热闹的咖啡店，你更爱在家看书，因为比较安静。: Your partner enjoys lively cafés. You prefer reading at home because it's quieter.
说 I walk through the park because it's q: Say “I walk through the park because it's quiet.” Make “park” and “quiet” clear and link through “because.” Try a different place and reason.
because 后接完整的小句，这里用 it's quiet。: Use a complete clause after “because,” in this case “it's quiet.”
从喜欢的地点和活动里各选一个，加一句理由。: Choose a place and an activity you like. Give a reason for each.
解释自己为什么选择某一种通勤方式。: Explain why you choose a particular way to get to work.
你喜欢在主路附近散步。问搭档偏好哪条路线和原因。: You enjoy walking near the main road. Ask which route your partner prefers and why.
你喜欢沿运河走，因为路上几乎没有汽车。你周三和周日才有空。: You like walking along the canal because there are hardly any cars. You're only free on Wednesdays and Sundays.
A 能复述路线及原因。: A repeats the route and the reason for choosing it.
用作息、兴趣、喜好和理由决定一项活动: Choose an activity based on routines, interests, preferences and reasons.
说出自己的一个时间限制: Describe one limit on your availability.
按访客喜好提议活动: Suggest an activity that suits the visitor's interests.
doesn't like long walks 给出了要避开的活动。: “Doesn't like long walks” identifies the activity to avoid.
为什么提议去办公楼后面？: Why suggest going behind the office building?
Oli 用 because it's close 解释为什么可行。: Oli explains why it works by saying “because it's close.”
他们预计什么时候去？: When do they expect to go?
Mina 提议 twelve thirty，Oli 表示同意。: Mina suggests twelve thirty and Oli agrees.
告诉同伴你通常十二点半吃午饭，之后有半小时。: Tell your partner you usually eat lunch at twelve thirty and have half an hour free afterwards.
访客喜欢看画，不喜欢很吵的地方。提议去附近的小画廊。: The visitor enjoys paintings and dislikes noisy places. Suggest the small gallery nearby.
画廊今天关闭，换成安静的书店并说原因。: The gallery is closed today. Suggest a quiet bookshop instead and explain why.
伙伴依次随机读两个时间，写下 12:00 或 12:30。自己复述时，thirt: Have your partner say the two times in random order and write down 12:00 or 12:30. When repeating “thirty,” lightly touch your tongue tip to your teeth and let air through for “th.”
主语为 she 时，用 doesn't 加动词原形 like。: With “she” as the subject, use “doesn't” followed by the base form “like.”
不看台词，给出活动建议和一句理由。: Without looking at the script, suggest an activity and give one reason.
同伴午休只有二十分钟，调整活动并说出理由。: Your partner has only twenty minutes for lunch. Adjust the activity and explain why.
你十二点半才空，想带访客去近一点的地方。问清访客的兴趣和时间。: You're free from twelve thirty and want to take a visitor somewhere nearby. Ask about their interests and schedule.
访客喜欢看旧照片，不喜欢户外活动，一点要回去开会。办公室旁有小展厅，照片可以免费: The visitor enjoys old photographs, dislikes outdoor activities and has a meeting at one. The little exhibition hall beside the office has a free photography exhibit.
A 提议合适的地点和时间，并说出一个理由。: A suggests a suitable place and time and gives one reason.
独立询问日常安排和兴趣，并给出适合两人的方案: Ask about routines and interests on your own and propose a plan that suits you both.
主动问出对方的时间或兴趣: Take the initiative to ask about availability or interests.
说出一项明确的喜好或限制: State one specific preference or constraint.
确定双方可行的活动和时间，并说明理由: Agree on an activity and time that work for both of you and explain why.
Sol 周六早上通常做什么？: What does Sol usually do on Saturday mornings?
shop for food 是采购食物。: “Shop for food” means to buy groceries.
Kai 为什么提议沿运河骑车？: Why does Kai suggest cycling along the canal?
because it's quiet 解释了路线选择。: “Because it's quiet” explains the choice of route.
Sol 用 Let's go at eleven thirty 确定出发时间。: Sol settles the departure time with “Let's go at eleven thirty.”
室友只问了周日上午的安排。说你十点后空，并讲一项习惯。: Your roommate asks only about Sunday morning. Say you're free after ten and describe one habitual activity.
用自己的时间和习惯: Use your own schedule and habits.
室友不喜欢跑步，你想找替代活动。先问出他的户外偏好。: Your roommate dislikes running. Before suggesting something else, ask what they enjoy doing outdoors.
问兴趣，听完再决定: Ask about interests and listen before deciding.
对方喜欢看花但不能久站，建议坐在植物园里，并解释。: Your partner likes flowers but can't stand for long. Suggest sitting in the botanical garden and explain why.
把 busy places 分别放入 I like 和 I don't real: Say “busy places” after both “I like” and “I don't really like.” The listener should identify the type of place and whether you enjoy it.
like 后可接 riding my bike 来说明喜欢的活动。: You can say “like riding my bike” to name an activity you enjoy.
从你的回答中回听一条时间和一条理由，检查能否独立听懂。: Listen back to one time and one reason in your response. Can you understand each on its own?
换成同事午休安排，重新协商活动和时间。: Imagine making plans for a colleague's lunch break. Negotiate a new activity and time.
你周日十点后有空，喜欢安静的地方。和搭档谈妥一种周日活动。: You're free after ten on Sunday and enjoy quiet places. Agree on a Sunday activity with your partner.
你周日十一点半才有空，喜欢拍花，不喜欢拥挤。小公园有花，午后人少。: You're free from eleven thirty on Sunday. You like photographing flowers and dislike crowds. The small park has flowers and is quieter in the afternoon.
A 问到你独有的限制，给出符合两人条件的时间和活动及理由。: A finds out your particular constraint and suggests a time and activity that suit both people, with a reason.
在咖啡店和餐厅开口: Speaking up in cafés and restaurants
完成小额点单，核对数量和偏好，并在缺货时选替代品。: Place a small order, check quantities and preferences, and choose a substitute if something is sold out.
说清饮料、大小和堂食或外带: Specify your drink, size and whether you'll stay or take it away.
说清杯型和冷热: Specify the cup size and whether you want it hot or iced.
回答堂食或外带: Say whether you'll have it here or take it away.
客人先说 hot tea，再确认选 green tea。: The customer first asks for hot tea, then confirms green tea.
客人选多大的杯？: What cup size does the customer choose?
客人选了哪种取餐方式？: How does the customer want their order served?
到店二楼喝: To drink upstairs on the second floor
To go 是外带。: “To go” means to take it away.
店员问你堂食还是外带，选择堂食。: The server asks “For here or to go?” Choose to stay.
店员误以为你点的是热茶，改成大杯冰茶并选外带。: The server thinks you ordered hot tea. Change it to a large iced tea to go.
请同伴随机说 hot tea 或 iced tea。听完指向热饮或冷饮，然后复述: Have a partner say “hot tea” or “iced tea” at random. Point to the hot or cold drink, then repeat the whole phrase.
点一杯时可用 a small coffee。: To order one cup, you can say “a small coffee.”
先点一次热饮，再换一种冷饮，轮流回答杯型和是否外带。: Order a hot drink, then switch to a cold one. Take turns answering questions about size and takeaway.
在车站饮品店点单，说明你要在店里喝。: Order at a station café and say you'll drink it there.
你想要小杯冰茶外带。仅知道店里有茶，向店员确认品种。: You'd like a small iced tea to go. You know the shop offers tea, but need to ask which kinds.
绿茶只有热的，冰茶只有红茶。小杯有货。: Green tea is available only hot. The only iced option is black tea. Small cups are available.
A 选出可提供的饮料，B 核对杯型、冷热和外带。: A chooses an available drink. B checks the size, temperature and takeaway request.
下单时正确说明份数，并核对总数: Specify quantities when ordering and check the total.
前两项食物的数量说对: Give the correct quantities for the first two dishes.
听出并更正店员回读的数量: Catch and correct a quantity when the server reads back the order.
客人要几份汤？: How many servings of soup does the customer want?
two bowls of soup 意思是两碗汤。: “Two bowls of soup” means two separate bowls.
两人分着吃什么？: What are the two people sharing?
to share 紧跟在 one bread roll 后面。: “To share” comes immediately after “one bread roll.”
最后加点了什么？: What do they add at the end?
客人最后说 One salad, please。: The customer finishes with “One salad, please.”
为两个人点两碗汤。: Order two bowls of soup for two people.
再加一份两个人分的薯条。: Add one portion of fries to share between two people.
店员回读成三份汤，纠正为一份汤，再确认沙拉是两份。: The server reads back three soups. Correct it to one, then confirm two salads.
对比 one bowl 和 two bowls。读后让对方写下数量，留意数字与: Compare “one bowl” and “two bowls.” Have your partner write down each quantity. Both the number and the ending of “bowls” provide clues.
two 后面的可数名词 bowl 用复数 bowls。: After “two,” use the plural “bowls” for the countable noun “bowl.”
给自己写一张有三种食物的便签，反过来只看食物和数字练点单。: Make a note with three foods and their quantities. Turn it over, then practise ordering with only the food names and numbers as cues.
在三人早餐场景下说清谁要同样的东西。: At breakfast for three, explain who wants the same thing.
你们要两碗汤、一份沙拉，两个人分一个小面包。: You'd like two bowls of soup, one salad and a bread roll to share between two people.
你是店员，回读时把小面包误报为两个，等对方纠正。: You're the server. Read back two bread rolls by mistake and wait for the customer to correct you.
双方确认汤、沙拉和小面包的最终数量。: Both sides confirm the final quantities of soup, salad and bread rolls.
询问辣度，并指定配料是去掉还是分开放: Ask how spicy a dish is and specify which ingredients to omit or serve separately.
主动问到辣度: Ask how spicy the food is without prompting.
准确说明不加哪种配料: Specify exactly which ingredient to leave out.
区分不加与分开装: Distinguish between leaving something out and serving it separately.
客人选择了什么辣度？: What spice level does the customer choose?
客人接受 mild 这个选择。: The customer accepts the mild option.
客人希望去掉哪种配料？: Which ingredient would the customer like left out?
without onions 表示不加洋葱。: “Without onions” means leave out the onions.
酱汁怎么处理？: How should the sauce be served?
点面条前先确认辣不辣。: Before ordering noodles, find out whether they're spicy.
你想要微辣，去掉葱。: You'd like the dish mild, without spring onions.
沙拉到桌时酱汁没分开，礼貌说明你要另外放。: Your salad arrives with the dressing already on it. Politely explain that you wanted it on the side.
录下 without onions 和 without cheese。说清最后那: Record “without onions” and “without cheese.” Make the final ingredient clear so your partner can identify what to leave out.
先说要的东西 them，再用 without onions 补充偏好。: Refer to the noodles with “them” first, then add your preference with “without onions.”

街尾: At the end of the street
黄色招牌属于哪里？: Which place has the yellow sign?
The bakery has a yellow sign 指面包店的招牌。: “The bakery has a yellow sign” identifies the sign as the bakery's.
你在街上找一家银行，先礼貌发问。: You're in the street looking for a bank. Start with a polite question.
你听到银行在咖啡馆旁边，确认它是否在马路对面。: You hear that the bank is beside the café. Check whether it's across the road.
对方说银行在马路这边，咖啡馆旁边。复述确认。: The bank is on this side of the road, beside the café. Repeat this to check.
先分读 next 和 to，再放慢连起来读，保留 next 结尾的辅音位置。: Say “next” and “to” separately, then link them slowly, keeping the final consonant of “next” in place.
单数可数名词 pharmacy 前加 a。: Use “a” before the singular countable noun “pharmacy.”
明天画两个地标并说出相对位置。: Tomorrow, draw two landmarks and describe their positions relative to each other.
在商场里用 next to 和 across from 描述服务台。: Describe a mall's information desk using “next to” and “across from.”
礼貌询问附近有没有目标地点: Politely ask whether the place you're looking for is nearby.
用一个地标或街道方位追问: Ask a follow-up question using a landmark or a side of the street.
用一句话复述位置: Repeat the location in one sentence.
你要找一间洗手间，需弄清它和电梯的位置。: You need a restroom. Find out where it is in relation to the lift.
洗手间在这一层的电梯对面，但服务台旁边的是员工洗手间。: The restroom on this floor is opposite the lift. The one beside the information desk is for staff.
A 说出自己该去哪个洗手间，并描述它的位置。: A identifies which restroom to use and describes its location.
询问步行路线并按顺序复述: Ask for walking directions and repeat the steps in order.
第一个路口怎么走？: What should you do at the first junction?
Nora 说 Turn right at the corner。: Nora says, “Turn right at the corner.”
第二个动作是 turn left at the library。: The second instruction is “turn left at the library.”
最后一句说 big green gate。: The final line says “big green gate.”
在路口问图书馆怎么走。: At a street corner, ask how to get to the library.
给朋友两步路线：直走到红绿灯，再左转。: Give a friend two steps: go straight to the traffic lights, then turn left.
朋友以为先左转。纠正：先在桥边右转，再在银行左转。: Your friend thinks the first turn is left. Correct them: first turn right at the bridge, then left at the bank.
轮流读 left、right。读 left 时舌尖碰上齿龈，读 right 时舌: Alternate between “left” and “right.” Touch the ridge behind your upper teeth with your tongue tip for “left,” but keep it clear for “right.”
把路口当作转弯点时用 at。: Use “at” when naming the junction where someone should turn.
第二天画出公园的两个转弯。: The next day, draw the two turns on the way to the park.
用家附近两个地标口述步行路线。: Give walking directions aloud using two landmarks near home.
明确问到目标地点的路线: Ask explicitly how to get to your destination.
用 then 顺序串起两步: Use “then” to connect two steps in order.
指出每次转弯的地标: Name the landmark for each turn.
你从大楼大门出来，找附近的洗衣店。: You've just left the building and are looking for a nearby laundry.
从大门直走到红绿灯，左转；再到面包店右转，洗衣店在左手边。: From the main door, go straight to the lights and turn left. Turn right at the bakery. The laundry is on your left.
A 复述两个转弯和洗衣店所在的一侧。: A repeats both turns and the side of the street the laundry is on.
根据线路、时间和下车站选择交通方式: Choose transport based on the route, travel time and stop.
哪班车早上更快？: Which bus is faster in the morning?
6 路十分钟，10 路二十分钟。: Bus 6 takes ten minutes and bus 10 takes twenty.
坐 6 路在哪下？: Where do you get off bus 6?
Get off at Market Square 指定下车点。: “Get off at Market Square” identifies the stop.
走过什么店就能看到会堂入口？: Which shop do you pass just before the hall entrance?
入口在 just past the fruit shop。: The entrance is “just past the fruit shop.”
问去会堂能不能坐公交。: Ask whether you can take a bus to the hall.
朋友告诉你坐 8 路和 12 路都行。问哪班快和在哪下车。: Your friend says buses 8 and 12 both work. Ask which is faster and where to get off.
同伴有十五分钟。告诉他坐 3 路要十分钟，在湖路下车。: Your partner has fifteen minutes. Explain that bus 3 takes ten minutes and they should get off at Lake Road.
慢读 I take 和 It takes，在 takes 末尾保留 /s/，接着: Say “I take” and “It takes” slowly. Keep the final /s/ in “takes,” then add “about.”
一般现在时中用 do 帮助构成这个疑问句。: Use “do” to form this present simple question.
回想昨天的线路和下车站。: Recall yesterday's route and the stop where you got off.
同伴只能坐地铁，询问时间和下车站。: Your partner can only take the subway. Ask how long it takes and where to get off.
询问可用的交通方式: Ask what transport options are available.
用分钟数说明一个选择: Explain one option by giving its travel time in minutes.
问清或说清下车站: Ask for or specify the stop where you get off.
你要在二十分钟内到河湾展厅，问车程和下车站。: You have twenty minutes to reach Riverbend Exhibition Hall. Ask how long the ride takes and which stop you need.
4 路需二十五分钟，在河湾门口停；7 路需十二分钟，在东桥停，走四分钟可到。: Bus 4 takes twenty-five minutes and stops outside Riverbend. Bus 7 takes twelve minutes to East Bridge, followed by a four-minute walk.
A 选出能按时到的路线，念出站名并说明还要走几分钟。: A chooses a route that gets them there on time, names the stop and says how many minutes to walk.
用地址和地标区分同名地点: Use addresses and landmarks to distinguish places with the same name.
眼前的是哪扇门？: Which gate are they standing at?
Ella 说 this is the South Gate。: Ella says, “This is the South Gate.”
票上东门的地标是什么？: What landmark does the ticket give for the East Gate?
票上写着 next to a coffee shop。: The ticket says “next to a coffee shop.”
Ella 确认东门在 Mill Road。: Ella confirms that the East Gate is on Mill Road.
你持票找北门。告诉工作人员你在找什么。: Your ticket says North Gate. Tell a staff member what you're looking for.
面前的门没有标牌，问是不是湖路上的入口。: There's no sign on the gate in front of you. Ask whether it's the entrance on Lake Road.
有人说马路对面的入口只给员工用。确认你应去桥旁给访客用的入口。: Someone tells you the entrance across the road is for staff only. Check that you need the visitor entrance by the bridge.
读 Mill 时先闭双唇发 /m/；读 Hill 时双唇打开，用轻气流起音。: Close your lips for /m/ in “Mill.” For “Hill,” keep your lips open and start with a light breath.
用 am 加 looking 构成现在进行时。: Use “am” with “looking” to form the present continuous.
遮住文本，说出两条路分别通向哪个门。: Cover the text and say which gate each road leads to.
练习区分同名的医院门诊楼和住院楼入口。: Practise telling apart the outpatient and inpatient entrances at a hospital where both buildings share the same name.
说出要找的具体入口: Specify the entrance you're looking for.
用地址或地标再问一次: Ask again using an address or landmark.
复述并请对方确认: Repeat the details and ask for confirmation.
你找预约邮件里的西边访客门，邮件说在停车场旁。: Your appointment email directs you to the west visitor gate beside the car park. Find it.
这里西边有两个门：停车场旁的是访客门，装卸区旁的是员工门。: There are two gates on the west side: the visitor gate by the car park and the staff gate by the loading area.
A 说出自己要走的门并用地标核对。: A names the gate they need and checks it against the landmark.
在车站综合使用问位置、路线、交通和确认: At a station, ask about locations, directions and transport and confirm your route.
步行该走哪个出口？: Which exit should you use if you're walking?
Use exit two 指的是步行路线。: “Use exit two” applies to the walking route.
找不到书店: The bookshop is hard to find
花园巷公交站和正门是什么关系？: Where is the Garden Lane bus stop in relation to the main entrance?
从地铁站去菜市场，问哪个出口更合适。: Ask which subway exit is best for the produce market.
你从 3 号出口出来，看到书店。问去菜市场是不是要在那里右转。: You've come out of exit 3 and can see a bookshop. Ask whether you should turn right there for the market.
突然下雨，改坐 5 路，在松树街下，复述并确认市场入口在车站对面。: It starts raining. Switch to bus 5 and get off at Pine Street. Repeat the route and confirm that the market entrance is opposite the stop.
给 ex 加重音，再跟轻一点的 it，比较 exit two 中两个词的重音。: Stress “ex” and follow it with a lighter “it.” Compare the stresses on the two words in “exit two.”
疑问句把 should 放到主语 I 前。: Put “should” before the subject “I” in the question.
各复述一条步行和公交路线。: Describe one walking route and one bus route from memory.
用一张商场楼层图，问服务台的位置和最近电梯。: Use a mall floor plan to ask where the information desk and nearest lift are.
询问出口和一个步行转弯: Ask which exit to use and where to turn on foot.
改问公交并复述下车站: Switch to asking about the bus and repeat the stop where you get off.
核对公交站与指定入口的位置: Check where the bus stop is relative to the specified entrance.
你要去河湾中心的访客入口，带大箱子，优先找公交。: You need Riverbend Centre's visitor entrance. You're carrying a large suitcase and would prefer a bus.
步行走 4 号出口，在钟楼左转。坐 11 路走 3 号出口，在柳树街下车；访客入: On foot, use exit 4 and turn left at the clock tower. For bus 11, use exit 3 and get off at Willow Street. The visitor entrance is beside the stop; the staff entrance is opposite.
A 选公交，复述出口、下车站，并确认应使用的入口。: A chooses the bus, repeats the exit and stop, and checks which entrance to use.
完成一次全新的路线沟通并防止走错门: Navigate a new route and make sure you use the correct door.
多久能坐到指定下车站？: How long is the ride to the specified stop?
今天可以从哪扇门进去？: Which door can you use today?
自行车架旁的蓝门: The blue door beside the bike racks
告诉接待员你来参加陶艺课，十二分钟后开始。: Tell reception you're here for the pottery class, which starts in twelve minutes.
有人建议坐接驳车去北楼。确认车程与下车点。: Someone suggests taking the shuttle to the north building. Check the journey time and where to get off.
接待员说楼前门锁着，花园旁的侧门开着。复述交通和入口：坐到第一站，从侧门进。: Reception says the front door is locked but the side door by the garden is open. Repeat the transport and entrance details: ride to the first stop and go in the side door.
慢读 first stop 和 second stop，先分开读清词尾，再以自然: Say “first stop” and “second stop” slowly. Pronounce the word endings clearly in isolation, then repeat at a natural speed.
不看文本，用自己的话复述目的地、交通和入口。: Without reading, give the destination, transport and entrance in your own words.
为同伴设计两个门只开一个的路线任务。: Create a directions task for your partner with two doors, only one of which is open.
说出要去的活动及时间限制: Name the activity you're going to and how much time you have.
询问交通耗时及下车点: Ask about the travel time and where to get off.
根据新信息明确确认入口: Use the new information to confirm the correct entrance.
你是去松林活动中心上合唱课的访客，九分钟后开始；向工作人员问路。: You're visiting Pinewood Activity Centre for a choir class that starts in nine minutes. Ask a staff member for directions.
合唱在附楼。步行十二分钟；小电车三分钟，在第三站下，进庭院须走红门，绿门通向办公: Choir meets in the annex. Walking takes twelve minutes. The tram takes three minutes; get off at the third stop. Use the red gate for the courtyard. The green gate leads to the offices.
A 说明合唱课，选能按时到的交通，复述下车点及红门。: A names the choir class, chooses transport that gets them there on time and repeats the stop and the red gate.
问价、问颜色尺寸、比较、说明商品问题: Asking about prices, colours and sizes, comparing items and describing product problems
能确认商品规格和价格，并在商品有问题时询问处理方式: Check product specifications and prices and ask what can be done if there's a problem with an item.
问明单件和组合的价格: Ask how much one item costs and how much the set costs.
蓝色单买多少钱？: How much is the blue one on its own?
两本买一蓝一黑能享受组合价吗？: Can you get the two-notebook deal if you choose one blue and one black?
要问店长: You have to ask the manager
any two colors 指可任选颜色。: “Any two colors” means you can choose whichever two colours you like.
最终买了几本？: How many notebooks does the customer end up buying?
these two 明确买两本。: “These two” tells us the customer buys two notebooks.
问手里的杯子多少钱。: Ask how much the cup you're holding costs.
比较单买一个六美元和两个十美元。问绿色和白色能不能一起参加活动。: Compare one cup for six dollars with two for ten. Ask if a green cup and a white cup qualify for the deal together.
店员说绿色不参加，只剩两个同价的棕色杯子。你决定只买一个。: The green cups aren't included in the offer. Only two brown cups remain, both at the same price. Tell the server you'll buy just one.
is 和 are 随数量变化: Choosing “is” or “are” to match the quantity
交替读 How much is this? 和 How much are the: Alternate between “How much is this?” and “How much are these?” Make “this” and “these” sound distinct.
写出问单价和总价的两个问题。: Write two questions: one about the price of a single item and one about the total.
在花摊问三枝花一起多少钱。: At a flower stall, ask how much three flowers cost together.
用正确单复数问单价或总价: Use the correct singular or plural form to ask for the unit price or total.
确认混选颜色是否适用组合价: Check whether mixing colours qualifies for the deal.
你要给三位同事买便签，每人一本，问组合总价。: You're buying a notepad for each of three colleagues. Ask how much all three cost together.
一本五美元，三本同色共十二美元，混色无优惠。: One notepad is five dollars. Three of the same colour cost twelve dollars altogether. There's no discount for mixed colours.
A 问清两种总价并说出下单方式。: A checks the total for each option and says how they'd like to order.
询问颜色和尺码并请求试穿: Ask about colours and sizes and request to try something on.
蓝色有哪个尺码？: What size is available in blue?
店员说 blue one in medium。: The server says “blue one in medium.”
白色只有哪个尺码？: What is the only size available in white?
Only in large 是只有大码。: “Only in large” means large is the only size available.
Jin 试穿后怎么说？: What does Jin say after trying it on?
合身，决定购买: It fits and they'll buy it
fits well 后接 I'll take it。: “Fits well” is followed by “I'll take it.”
想找小码的这一款外套。: Ask for this style of jacket in a small.
确认这款有没有灰色，并问能不能试穿。: Check whether this style comes in grey and ask to try it on.
灰色仅有中码且偏大。你试了合适的小码蓝色外套，告诉店员你的选择。: The grey jacket comes only in medium and runs large. You've tried on the small blue jacket and it fits. Tell the assistant which one you'll take.
small 的开头和结尾: The first and last sounds in “small”
把 /s/ 直接接到 /m/；最后读到 /l/ 就收住，再接后面的名词。: Move straight from /s/ into /m/. Finish on /l/ before saying the noun that follows.
问某款商品的尺码用 in medium。: Use “in medium” to ask whether an item is available in that size.
回忆白色和蓝色的库存，轮换尺码练问法。: Recall which sizes were in stock in white and blue. Practise the question with different sizes.
挑选有尺码的工装手套。: Choose a pair of work gloves in the right size.
明确问一款商品的尺码和颜色: Ask specifically which sizes and colours an item comes in.
礼貌请求试穿: Politely ask to try it on.
用尺码或颜色说清最终选择: Specify your final choice by size or colour.
你想买中码夹克，优先灰色但能接受绿色，想试穿。: You'd like a medium jacket. You prefer grey but would consider green. Ask to try one on.
灰色仅小码，绿色有中码；试衣间在楼梯旁。: Grey comes only in small. Green is available in medium. The fitting room is beside the stairs.
A 问清库存，请求试穿并复述选到的款式。: A checks availability, asks to try a jacket on and repeats which one they've chosen.
比较价格和重量并解释取舍: Compare price and weight and explain your choice.
The gray one is cheaper 明确给出比较结果。: “The gray one is cheaper” states the result of the comparison.
为什么最终选绿色？: Why choose the green bag in the end?
Fei 说 because it's lighter。: Fei gives the reason: “because it's lighter.”
两个水杯中，你想问哪个更轻。: Ask which of the two water bottles is lighter.
白色杯十二美元，银色十六美元。说明谁更便宜。: The white bottle costs twelve dollars and the silver one costs sixteen. Say which is cheaper.
你每天背杯子出门，银杯更轻，选银杯并说明原因。: You carry the bottle every day. Choose the lighter silver one and explain why.
先读重一点的 cheap、light，再加轻一点的结尾 -er。: Stress “cheap” and “light,” then add a lighter “-er” ending.
cheaper 已是比较级，不再加 more。: “Cheaper” is already comparative, so don't add “more.”
闭眼复述两款哪个轻、哪个便宜。: Close your eyes and recall which item is lighter and which is cheaper.
比较两种充电宝的体积和价格。: Compare two power banks in terms of size and price.
询问一个可比较的特征: Ask about a feature you can compare.
用正确的比较级对比两款: Use the appropriate comparative to describe the difference.
依据自己的需求解释选择: Explain your choice in terms of what you need.
你要选一盏台灯，预算二十五美元，桌面很窄。: Choose a desk lamp. Your budget is twenty-five dollars and your desk is very narrow.
白灯二十美元，底座宽；蓝灯二十四美元，底座小。: The white lamp costs twenty dollars and has a wide base. The blue one costs twenty-four dollars and has a small base.
A 问清价格和底座大小，选一款并解释。: A checks the prices and base sizes, chooses a lamp and explains why.
说清商品问题并问能否换货: Describe a problem with an item and ask to exchange it.
杯子哪里有问题？: Where is the problem with the cup?
near the handle 是杯把附近。: “Near the handle” locates the problem close to the cup's handle.
店员问 receipt，Hui 回答 here it is。: The assistant asks for the receipt and Hui replies, “Here it is.”
店里还有哪种颜色？: Which colour does the shop still have?
only have yellow today 限定了库存。: “Only have yellow today” tells us which colour is currently in stock.
把不亮的台灯带回店里，说昨天在这里买的。: Take the lamp that won't light up back to the shop. Say you bought it there yesterday.
你带了小票并想换货，跟店员说。: Tell the assistant you have the receipt and would like an exchange.
店员说只有不同颜色的同款。你问有无白色，并决定有没有白色就换绿。: The same model is available only in other colours. Ask if they have white. If they don't, choose green.
圈出 receipt 里不发音的 p，把重音放在后半个音节。: Circle the silent “p” in “receipt” and stress the second syllable.
描述某处有裂纹用 there is。: Use “there is” to say there's a crack in a particular place.
用两句话说购买时间和具体故障。: Use two sentences to say when you bought the item and exactly what's wrong with it.
用拉链拉不动的包练询问换货。: Practise asking to exchange a bag with a stuck zip.
说清购买时间与物品: Identify the item and when you bought it.
指明故障位置或动作: Say where the fault is or what the item won't do.
礼貌问能否换货并核对库存: Politely ask for an exchange and check what's in stock.
你的新雨伞打不开。想换同色，有电子小票。: Your new umbrella won't open. You'd like the same colour and have a digital receipt.
电子小票可用；同色伞明天到货，黑色今天可以换。: A digital receipt is fine. The same colour arrives tomorrow, or you can exchange it for a black one today.
A 说明故障，提供小票，并对库存作出明确选择。: A describes the fault, offers the receipt and makes a clear choice based on availability.
在同一笔购买里核对价格、规格和商品状态: Check the price, specifications and condition of an item during a single purchase.
小号多少钱？: How much is the small one?
It's fourteen dollars 是小号价格。: “It's fourteen dollars” gives the price of the small one.
大号与小号比怎么样？: How does the large one compare with the small one?
小号更轻，大号多四美元。: The small one is lighter. The large one costs four dollars more.
doesn't close 表示关不上。: “Doesn't close” describes a lid that won't shut.
问绿色小饭盒价格和有无白色。: Ask how much the small green lunchbox costs and whether it comes in white.
你想知道白色大号和绿色小号哪个轻。: Find out which is lighter: the large white one or the small green one.
绿色小饭盒扣不上，问能不能看另一个同款。: The small green lunchbox won't fasten. Ask to see another one in the same style.
先读后重音的 fourTEEN，再读前重音的 FORty。让同伴打乱读，你写下价: Say fourTEEN with stress at the end, then FORty with stress at the start. Have a partner say them in random order and write down the prices.
回忆价差和无法关上的部件。: Recall the price difference and which part wouldn't close.
独立挑选一把合适的折叠伞并检查开合。: Choose a suitable folding umbrella on your own and check that it opens and closes.
问清一款商品的价格和一项规格: Ask about an item's price and one specification.
用比较级确认哪款符合需求: Use a comparative to check which item meets your needs.
指出故障并请求查看另一件: Point out the fault and ask to see another one.
你要买一个价格不超过二十美元的轻便午餐袋，颜色优先蓝色。: You need a lightweight lunch bag costing no more than twenty dollars. Blue is your first choice.
大蓝袋十九美元，较重；小蓝袋十七美元，较轻但样品拉链坏了。仓库有完好的小灰袋，同: The large blue bag costs nineteen dollars and is heavier. The small blue one costs seventeen and is lighter, but the display model's zip is broken. There's an undamaged small grey bag in the stockroom at the same price.
A 查价和规格，遇到故障后问库存并选出可用商品。: A checks the price and specifications. After finding a fault, A asks about stock and chooses an item that works.
在新场景里核对库存和价格后作出选择: In a new shopping situation, check availability and price before choosing.
为什么需要换鞋？: Why do the shoes need exchanging?
一只鞋的鞋底松了: The sole on one shoe is loose
One sole is loose 给出故障。: “One sole is loose” describes the fault.
棕色同款需要多付吗？: Does the same style in brown cost extra?
it's the same price 说明不用加价。: “It's the same price” confirms there's no extra charge.
决定前 Wei 想做什么？: What does Wei want to do before deciding?
try the lighter pair on 表示试穿。: “Try the lighter pair on” means put them on to check the fit.
你买的两只手套中一只破了，问能否换。: One glove in the pair you bought has a hole. Ask if you can exchange it.
你想换中码黑色，问同尺码的灰色是不是一样价。: You want a medium pair in black. Ask if grey in the same size costs the same.
预算充足。轻便款贵三美元，你打算先试穿再选。: The lighter style costs three dollars more and is within budget. Try it on before choosing.
读 one pair，再读 two pairs，重复时保留 pairs 末尾的: Say “one pair,” then “two pairs.” Keep the final /z/ when you repeat “pairs.”
复述故障、可选颜色和差价，再换一种商品重试。: Repeat the fault, available colours and price difference. Try again with a different item.
用课堂以外的日常用品设计一次询价换货对话。: Choose an everyday item from outside class and create a dialogue about its price and an exchange.
说明商品问题并提出换货: Describe the fault and ask to exchange the item.
问清替代规格及差价: Check the specifications of the alternative and any price difference.
依据条件决定试用或接受选项: Use the conditions to decide whether to try an item or accept an offer.
你的黑色跑步鞋鞋带孔破了，穿四十二码，最多愿意加四美元。: An eyelet on your black running shoes is torn. You wear size 42 and are willing to pay up to four dollars extra.
四十二码只有蓝色同款可同价换；轻便的黑色另款加六美元；两款均可试穿。: In size 42, only blue is available in the same style at no extra charge. A lighter black style costs six dollars extra. Both can be tried on.
A 说明问题、问尺码颜色和价差，再选出预算内的方案。: A explains the fault, asks about size, colour and price difference, then chooses an option within budget.
昨天、周末、事情的顺序、结果和感受: Yesterday and the weekend, the order of events, outcomes and feelings
能用简单过去时和顺序词讲一件事，并回应对方的追问: Tell a short story using the simple past and sequence words, and answer follow-up questions.
交换昨天的活动和时间: Compare what you did yesterday and when.
bought some fruit 表示买了水果。: “Bought some fruit” tells us she purchased fruit.
什么时候到市场？: When did she arrive at the market?
她在市场之后做了什么？: What did she do after visiting the market?
和妹妹吃晚饭: Had dinner with her younger sister
她说 met my sister for dinner。: She says she “met my sister for dinner.”
问同事昨天下班后做了什么。: Ask a colleague what they did after work yesterday.
你昨天六点去了超市，买了面包。说出时间和活动。: Yesterday you went to the supermarket at six and bought bread. Give the time and describe the activity.
同伴以为你买完就回家。实际你去看了朋友，纠正并问同伴昨晚在哪吃饭。: Your partner assumes you went straight home after shopping. You actually visited a friend. Correct them and ask where they had dinner last night.
慢读 bought some，先练到 bought 的 /t/ 再接 some，: Say “bought some” slowly. Practise the final /t/ of “bought” and move into “some” without adding a vowel.
did 已表示过去，后面用 buy 原形。: “Did” already marks the past, so use the base form “buy.”
遮住原文，说出买了什么以及之后的活动。: Cover the text and say what was bought and what happened afterwards.
问同伴前天午饭后做了什么。: Ask your partner what they did after lunch the day before yesterday.
用 did 问昨天的活动: Use “did” to ask about yesterday's activities.
用过去式说出活动和时间: Use the past tense to say what happened and when.
自然追问一个细节: Ask a natural follow-up question about one detail.
你想知道同伴昨天是否找到附近可以坐下吃饭的地方。: Find out if your partner found somewhere nearby to sit down and eat yesterday.
你昨天五点去花店，之后在柳树街的白门餐馆吃饭，那里有座位。先等对方询问。: You went to a flower shop at five yesterday, then ate at the White Door restaurant on Willow Street. It has seating. Wait for your partner to ask.
A 问到昨天两项活动及餐馆位置。: A finds out about yesterday's two activities and where the restaurant is.
说清周末活动并追问细节: Describe weekend activities and ask for details.
哪天去的湖边？: Which day did they visit the lake?
I went with my cousin 说明同行人。: “I went with my cousin” identifies the companion.
下午步道怎么样？: What was the trail like in the afternoon?
it was quiet 表示人少安静。: “It was quiet” suggests there were few people around.
周一见到同事，问他的周末过得怎么样。: On Monday, ask a colleague how their weekend was.
你周六跟邻居一起去夜市，逛了一小时。: On Saturday you spent an hour at the night market with your neighbour.
听说同伴去了河边，问和谁一起、那里人多不多。: Your partner went to the riverside. Ask who went with them and whether it was crowded.
先读问句 How was your weekend?，was 轻读；再慢读 Ye: Ask “How was your weekend?” with a light “was.” Then say “Yes, it was” slowly, stressing “was.”
主语是 we，过去时用 were。: With “we” as the subject, use “were” in the past tense.
复述是哪天、和谁去以及走了多久。: Recall which day it was, who went along and how long they walked.
聊上一个休息日的室内活动。: Talk about something you did indoors on your last day off.
用一句话开始周末话题: Start a conversation about the weekend in one sentence.
说出日期和同行人或持续时间: Give the day and say who came along or how long the activity lasted.
用过去时追问一个细节: Ask a follow-up question about one detail using the past tense.
你想知道同伴的周末，并找一个适合安静散步的地方。: Ask about your partner's weekend and find somewhere for a quiet walk.
周六与同事去灯桥公园；上午安静，午后有市集，人很多。: On Saturday you went to Lantern Bridge Park with a colleague. It was quiet in the morning, but an afternoon market drew a crowd.
A 问到活动、同伴和哪个时段适合散步。: A finds out what their partner did, who joined them and when the park is good for walking.
按时间顺序讲述三步经历: Tell a three-step story in chronological order.
在门边看植物: Looked at plants by the door
First 指向门边看植物。: “First” introduces looking at the plants by the door.
买下植物后怎么做？: What happened after they bought the plant?
After that 后说帮朋友。: After “After that,” the speaker mentions helping a friend.
收好箱子回家: Packed up the boxes and went home
Finally 后说明收箱回家。: “Finally” introduces packing up the boxes and going home.
你先在书摊看了几本书。: Start by describing how you browsed some books at a bookstall.
接着买一本，之后和朋友喝茶。: Next, say you bought a book and then had tea with a friend.
活动计划临时变了。事后说明：先等公交，然后步行，最后错过开场。: Your plans changed at the last minute. Describe what happened: first you waited for a bus, then you walked, and finally you missed the start.
先把词尾读成短 /t/，再把 looked at 连起来读，避免添加一个音节。: Pronounce the ending as a short /t/. Then link “looked at” without adding a syllable.
叙述昨天发生的事，buy 的过去式是 bought。: When describing yesterday's events, use “bought,” the past tense of “buy.”
按顺序回忆三件事，去掉中文提示。: Recall three events in order without the Chinese prompts.
讲一次出门办事的三个动作。: Describe three steps in an errand you ran.
把中间动作放在正确顺序: Put the middle actions in the correct order.
用最后一步结束并使用过去式: Close with the final step and use the past tense.
同伴昨天参加修理活动，你错过了，问具体流程。: Your partner went to a repair event yesterday and you missed it. Ask what happened step by step.
先登记，再等到号码被叫，最后在志愿者帮助下修好玩具。: First you signed in, then waited for your number to be called, and finally fixed your toy with a volunteer's help.
A 获取并按原顺序复述三个动作。: A finds out the three actions and repeats them in their original order.
联系发生的结果与自己的感受: Connect what happened with how you felt.
为什么起初紧张？: Why did the speaker feel nervous at first?
I didn't know anyone 说明起初没有认识的人。: “I didn't know anyone” explains that nobody there was familiar at first.
最后做出的东西怎么样？: How did the dish turn out?
it tasted good 说明汤味道好。: “It tasted good” tells us the soup turned out well.
为什么下课后高兴？: Why was the speaker happy after class?
比别人快: They finished faster than everyone else
because I learned something new 给出原因。: “Because I learned something new” gives the reason.
告诉同事你第一次上课有点紧张。: Tell a colleague you felt a little nervous in your first class.
你和同学做了沙拉，味道很好，说出结果。: You and a classmate made a salad and it tasted good. Describe the result.
你最后没做完画，但很高兴认识了新朋友。: You didn't finish your painting, but you were glad you made a new friend.
并排慢读 glad、sad，保持两词的 /æ/ 一致，嘴张开，舌位偏前。: Say “glad” and “sad” slowly, side by side. Keep the same /æ/ sound in both, with your mouth open and your tongue towards the front.
描述感觉时，felt 后用形容词 happy。: Use the adjective “happy” after “felt” to describe a feeling.
回忆人物课前课后分别有什么感受。: Recall how the speaker felt before and after class.
讲一次先担心、后来顺利完成的小事。: Describe a small task you worried about at first but completed successfully.
说出起初的感受: Say how you felt at first.
用 because 说明最后感受的原因: Use “because” to explain how you felt at the end.
你知道同伴第一次参加小区活动，关心进展和感受。: It was your partner's first neighbourhood event. Ask how it went and how they felt.
起初担心找不到队友，后来和邻居搭档修好了一辆自行车。你很开心，因为能骑车回家。: At first you worried you wouldn't find a teammate. Later you fixed a bike with a neighbour. You were happy because you could ride home.
A 问清起初感受、结果和最后高兴的原因。: A finds out how their partner felt initially, what happened and why they were happy afterwards.
结合活动、顺序和结果讲清周末经历: Describe a weekend experience with the activities, their sequence and the outcome.
最初为什么没看成？: Why couldn't the speaker see the film at first?
走错门: They went to the wrong door
the first show was full 说明票都卖完了。: “The first show was full” means all the tickets were taken.
等候时去了哪里？: Where did the speaker go while waiting?
I went to a bookshop nearby 表示去了附近书店。: “I went to a bookshop nearby” identifies the place they visited.
Liv 对等待的感受是什么？: How does Liv feel about waiting?
I was glad I stayed 说明觉得等待值得。: “I was glad I stayed” suggests the wait felt worthwhile.
问朋友上周日下午去了哪里。: Ask your friend where they went last Sunday afternoon.
你的第一班车没赶上。先买了下一班的票，再在车站吃午饭。: You missed the first service. Describe buying a ticket for the next one and then eating lunch at the station.
最后车晚到了，但同伴还在等你。说出感受和原因。: Your bus arrived late, but your partner was still waiting. Say how you felt and why.
先读 stay，再带嗓音轻收 /d/，试着接上 for the next sho: Say “stay,” then finish lightly with a voiced /d/. Try adding “for the next show.”
didn't 后用动词原形。: Use the base form of the verb after “didn't.”
用三句概括原计划、调整和结果。: Summarise the original plan, the change and the outcome in three sentences.
讲一次没赶上约定后如何调整。: Describe how you adjusted your plans after missing an appointment.
交代过去的时间和原计划: Give the time in the past and the original plan.
说出结果并表达感受: Give the outcome and say how you felt.
问同伴昨天原本计划做什么，并弄清它是否完成。: Ask what your partner originally planned to do yesterday and find out whether they managed it.
你原想修自行车，店没开；先借了邻居的工具，再查说明，最后修好了，很自豪。: You wanted to repair your bike, but the shop was closed. You borrowed a neighbour's tools, checked the instructions and finally fixed it. You felt proud.
A 问清变化，用三句复述经过并说出同伴的感受。: A asks what changed, retells the events in three sentences and describes their partner's feelings.
在未练过的情境里转述事件和感受: Retell events and feelings in an unfamiliar situation.
刚要上课时: Just as class was about to start
right before the class 指快要上课时。: “Right before the class” means just before class started.
老师先做了什么？: What did the teacher do first?
查看会堂房间: Checked a room in the hall
First, she checked a room 说明先看房间。: “First, she checked a room” tells us she looked at the room first.
学到了新舞步: She learned a new dance step
We had more space inside 解释惊喜。: “We had more space inside” explains the pleasant surprise.
你知道昨天下雨，确认户外读书会取消了吗。: You know it rained yesterday. Check whether the outdoor book club was cancelled.
你负责向没来的人说：先等了十分钟，再带书进咖啡馆。: Tell someone who missed it what happened: you waited ten minutes, then took your books into a café.
尽管没坐到室外，你很高兴，因为来了三位新朋友。: Although you didn't get to sit outside, you were happy because three new friends came.
把 started 末尾读成一个轻音节 /ɪd/，和 walked 的词尾对比。: Give “started” a light final syllable, /ɪd/. Compare it with the ending of “walked.”
过一天用新的活动、场地和结果再讲一次。: A day later, tell the story again with a new activity, location and outcome.
采访同伴一次因天气临时调整的经历。: Interview your partner about a time the weather forced a last-minute change of plan.
用过去时追问事情如何调整: Use the past tense to ask how the plan changed.
按时间顺序转述两项行动: Retell two actions in chronological order.
用具体结果解释感受: Explain a feeling using a specific outcome.
你没参加昨天本来在河边的摄影活动，采访同伴并告诉另一位朋友。: You missed yesterday's photography event, originally planned for the riverside. Interview your partner and tell another friend what happened.
河边风太大。带队人先检查车站大厅，再把人领到大厅旁的有顶走廊。大家拍到了雨中的街: It was too windy by the river. The leader checked the station hall, then took everyone to the covered walkway beside it. You were pleased with the photos you took of the rainy street.
A 问出变动原因、两步安排和满意的理由，并复述。: A finds out why the plan changed, what the group did in two steps and why their partner was pleased, then retells the story.
近期计划、建议、接受和婉拒、替代方案: Upcoming plans, suggestions, accepting and declining, and alternative arrangements
能问对方的计划，协商一个双方可行的新安排，并复述确认: Ask about someone's plans, agree on a new arrangement that works for both of you and repeat it to confirm.
询问近期安排并说明空闲时间: Ask about upcoming plans and explain when you're free.
Dev 六点要做什么？: What does Dev need to do at six?
pick up a package 表示取包裹。: “Pick up a package” means to collect a parcel.
Dev 今晚几点以后有空？: After what time is Dev free tonight?
I'm free after eight 给出可用时段。: “I'm free after eight” gives Dev's availability.
问同事明天下班后有什么安排。: Ask a colleague about their plans after work tomorrow.
明天晚上六点要买菜，七点以后有空。: Tomorrow evening you're going grocery shopping at six and are free after seven.
同伴想六点半通话，你那时还在路上，提出八点通话。: Your partner wants to call at six thirty, but you'll still be on your way home. Suggest eight instead.
先清楚读完整的 going to，再把 to 读轻，下一动词 pick up 读: Start by saying “going to” clearly in full. Then lighten “to” while keeping the next verb, “pick up,” clear.
be going to 的主语为 I 时用 am。: With “I” as the subject, use “am” in “be going to.”
写下明晚一个计划及你实际可用的时段，大声说出。: Write down a plan for tomorrow evening and the time you're actually available. Say both aloud.
向朋友询问周日白天的安排。: Ask a friend about their plans during the day on Sunday.
问出对方某一时段的计划: Ask what someone has planned for a specific time.
用 be going to 说出活动: Describe an activity using “be going to.”
说清可用时间或重新约时间: Explain when you're available or suggest a new time.
你想在晚饭前和同事通话，自己只在六点半至七点空闲。: You want to call a colleague before dinner and are free only between six thirty and seven.
你六点半还在乘车，六点四十五到家，七点开始做饭。: You'll still be travelling at six thirty. You get home at six forty-five and start cooking at seven.
A 问清安排并与 B 确认六点四十五至七点内的时间。: A checks the schedule and confirms a time with B between six forty-five and seven.
在共同目标下提出活动和时间: Suggest an activity and a time that suit a shared goal.
为什么想安排一个短活动？: Why do they want a short activity?
before dinner 表示活动在晚饭前。: “Before dinner” places the activity before the meal.
他们准备走哪条路？: Which route are they planning to take?
咖啡店后面的小路: The path behind the coffee shop
path behind the coffee shop 指定路线。: “Path behind the coffee shop” specifies the route.
最后说好在哪里见？: Where do they finally agree to meet?
outside the coffee shop 是见面点。: “Outside the coffee shop” is the meeting point.
给下班后有二十分钟空闲的同事提议喝咖啡。: Suggest coffee to a colleague who has twenty minutes free after work.
同事接受。提议去车站附近的咖啡店。: Your colleague accepts. Suggest the coffee shop near the station.
车站门口正在施工，改约在书店门口见。: There's construction at the station entrance. Change the meeting point to the bookshop entrance.
先读 How aBOUT，再加 a short WALK；让 WALK 清晰突出: Say “How aBOUT,” then add “a short WALK.” Let “WALK” stand out and say the function words lightly.
Let's 后面直接接动词原形。: Use the base form of the verb directly after “Let's.”
用 How about 和 Let's 各说一个建议。: Make two suggestions, one with “How about” and one with “Let's.”
给只有十五分钟午休的同事提议一个活动。: Suggest an activity for a colleague whose lunch break is only fifteen minutes.
提出一个符合时间条件的活动: Suggest an activity that fits the available time.
提出具体的行动或路线: Propose a specific action or route.
协商清楚见面点和时间: Agree on an exact meeting point and time.
你有三十分钟，想和同伴散步或买咖啡，之后要赶车。: You have thirty minutes to take a walk or get coffee with your partner before catching your ride.
河边步行来回四十分钟；车站旁咖啡店等候约十分钟，你喜欢喝咖啡。: A walk to the river and back takes forty minutes. The café by the station has a wait of about ten minutes. You like coffee.
双方讨论后确认一个来得及的活动与见面点。: Discuss the options and agree on an activity you have time for and a meeting point.
清楚答应或简短说明不能参加: Accept clearly or briefly explain why you can't join.
为什么周五不能去？: Why can't they go on Friday?
不想看: They don't want to see it
I'm working late on Friday 交代原因。: “I'm working late on Friday” gives the reason.
最终选的是哪一场？: Which screening do they choose in the end?
Yes, five is fine 确认五点场。: “Yes, five is fine” confirms the five o'clock screening.
meet at the cinema at four thirty 约的是碰面。: “Meet at the cinema at four thirty” sets the time to meet.
邀请同事周四晚上一起吃面。: Invite a colleague to have noodles together on Thursday evening.
朋友邀请你星期四吃饭，你要上课。礼貌婉拒。: A friend invites you to dinner on Thursday, but you have class. Decline politely.
朋友改提周日十二点。你能接受，并确认在餐厅见。: Your friend suggests noon on Sunday instead. Accept and check that you'll meet at the restaurant.
先读 I would love to，再读 I'd love to。保留 I'd: Say “I would love to,” then “I'd love to.” Keep the brief /d/ at the end of “I'd” and stress “love.”
主语 Saturday 是单数，work 在这里用 works。: “Saturday” is a singular subject, so use “works” here.
对一条邀请分别练接受和婉拒。: Practise both accepting and politely declining the same invitation.
用两种方式回应一次午休运动邀请。: Respond in two different ways to an invitation to exercise at lunchtime.
礼貌发出带时间的邀请: Give a polite invitation that includes a time.
婉拒并简短交代原因: Decline politely and give a brief reason.
接受可行提议并复述时间或地点: Accept a workable suggestion and repeat the time or place.
你想约同伴听现场音乐，周四八点和周六四点有场，自己两场都可以。: Invite your partner to hear live music. There are shows at eight on Thursday and four on Saturday. Both work for you.
周四得照看孩子，可以周六去，但最早三点四十五能到门口。: You have to look after a child on Thursday. Saturday works, but the earliest you can reach the entrance is three forty-five.
A 给出邀请与替代选项，B 婉拒周四并接受周六，双方明确集合时间。: A offers an invitation and an alternative. B declines Thursday and accepts Saturday. Agree on a precise meeting time.
指出限制并提议替代地点: Explain a constraint and suggest an alternative place.
为什么想换到室内？: Why do they want to move indoors?
公园太远: The park is too far away
明早要下雨: It's going to rain tomorrow morning
it's going to rain tomorrow morning 给出原因: “It's going to rain tomorrow morning” explains why.
咖啡店为何不行？: Why won't the coffee shop work?
closed on Mondays 意为周一歇业。: “Closed on Mondays” means the shop doesn't open on Mondays.
最终几点在哪见？: Where and when do they finally agree to meet?
十一点在咖啡店: At the coffee shop at eleven

重读 vail，其余音节缩短。: Stress “vail” and shorten the other syllables.

用品周四可取，须周五晚还；体验课只有周日上午十一点有位，需要提前十分钟到。仅回答: Supplies are available for pickup on Thursday and must be returned by Friday evening. The only trial class available is Sunday at eleven, with arrival ten minutes early. Respond only to the chosen branch.

对方说 east door is by the taxi stop。: The speaker says the “east door is by the taxi stop.”
预算约十二美元，小盒是十，茶罐是十六。: The budget is about twelve dollars. The small box is ten and the tin is sixteen.

脱稿交代会合入口、预算和购物地点。: Without a script, give the meeting entrance, budget and shopping location.

说清碰面后下一步: Explain the next step after meeting.
