车站北口封闭，只能从南口出来；礼品店有 14 元明信片套装，四点关门。: The station's north exit is closed. Everyone must leave by the south exit. The gift shop sells a postcard set for fourteen yuan and closes at four.
一起定安全可行的出站会合点及可以买到的礼物。: Agree on a safe, practical meeting point outside the station and a gift you can buy.
结课综合运用开场、路线、消费调整和结束: Final challenge: start a conversation, navigate, adjust a purchase and close the conversation.
确认对方是不是要和你一起活动的新同伴。: Check whether the other person is the new partner joining your activity.
你不确定是书店旁还是咖啡店旁，问清楚。: You're unsure whether they said beside the bookshop or beside the café. Ask for clarification.
公交改为十一点到，复述新会合时间及预算内的食物。: The bus will now arrive at eleven. Repeat the new meeting time and a food choice within budget.
公交几点到站？: What time does the bus reach the stop?
My bus gets to Elm Stop at ten thirty 是到: “My bus gets to Elm Stop at ten thirty” gives the arrival time. Ten forty is the meeting time.
展馆正门: At the exhibition hall's main entrance
对方纠正为 The door by the bookshop。: The other person corrects it to “the door by the bookshop.”
最后打算买什么？: What do they finally plan to buy?
水果杯符合八美元预算，末句也确认买水果。: The fruit cup fits the eight-dollar budget, and the final line confirms they'll buy fruit.
side 尾音是 /d/，site 尾音是 /t/；先单读再放回 side do: “Side” ends in /d/ and “site” ends in /t/. Practise the words separately, then say “side door.”
回想对话里哪一次误听改变了路线，并说出纠正句。: Recall which misunderstanding changed the route and say the line that corrected it.
换成接新同事去社区活动，询问入口、到达时间和一项饮食偏好。: Imagine meeting a new colleague for a community event. Ask about the entrance, arrival time and one dietary preference.
用开场确认同伴身份: Open by confirming your partner's identity.
澄清并复述正确集合门和时间: Clarify and repeat the correct meeting entrance and time.
在饮食及预算条件下选定食物并复述安排: Choose food that meets the dietary and budget constraints, and repeat the arrangements.
你初次接待新同伴，想一起看展，要确认会合点及先吃什么，早餐不超过 10 元。: You're welcoming a new partner for the first time and planning to see an exhibition together. Confirm where to meet and what to eat first. Breakfast must cost no more than ten yuan.
展馆正门维修，侧门九点半开；咖啡店有 8 元饭团、12 元三明治；你的公交十点到: The exhibition hall's main entrance is under repair. The side door opens at nine thirty. The café sells rice balls for eight yuan and sandwiches for twelve. Your bus arrives at ten.
确认双方身份、会合门和时间、预算内早餐，并复述新安排。: Confirm who you both are, the meeting entrance and time, and a breakfast within budget. Then repeat the new arrangements.
分别观察听声音、看文字和自己开口时的表现: Compare how you do when listening, reading and speaking on your own.
先听声音抓住安排: Listen first to pick out the arrangement.
再看文字核对理解: Then read the text to check your understanding.
不用稿子回应一个新问题: Answer a new question without a script.
Ben 三点之前无法到达，双方最终确认 three。: Ben can't arrive before three, and both speakers finally confirm three.
Mia 明确说 the west gate；公交站是旁边的参照物。: Mia specifies “the west gate.” The bus stop nearby is a landmark.
Which gate? 表示他需要确认见面的门。: “Which gate?” shows that Ben needs to check which entrance they're meeting at.
不用稿子，说出自己的名字、城市和一个兴趣。可用化名。: Without a script, give your name, city and one interest. You may use a made-up name.
朋友问：Are you free on Sunday? 你周日上午没空，下午四点: A friend asks, “Are you free on Sunday?” You're busy Sunday morning but free at four in the afternoon. Respond and suggest a time.
没空的时间 → 有空的时间: When you're busy → when you're free
对方提到一个你没听清的地点。请求重复，再确认是否在车站附近。: Someone names a place you didn't catch. Ask them to repeat it, then check whether it's near the station.
请求重复 → 确认位置: Ask for repetition → confirm the location
先观察，不追求满分: Observe your performance first, without aiming for a perfect score.
第一次回答不要查词或背稿。卡住可以停顿，真实记录需要哪些提示。: On your first attempt, don't look up words or memorise a script. It's fine to pause. Record honestly which hints you need.
表达自己没空使用 be not free。: To say you're unavailable, use a negative form of “be” with “free,” as in “I'm not free.”
一周后换一段全新对话再试。: Try again in a week using a completely new conversation.
把日期换成周五，把地点换成图书馆门口，再回应邀请。: Change the day to Friday and the meeting place to the library entrance. Respond to the invitation again.
能不用稿子介绍自己至少两项信息: I can introduce myself without a script and give at least two details.
能回应邀请并提出可行时间: I can respond to an invitation and suggest a workable time.
能请求重复并确认一个信息: I can ask for repetition and confirm one detail.
邀请对方周日见面，并确认时间地点。: Invite your partner to meet on Sunday and confirm the time and place.
你周日上午没空，下午五点有空，想在图书馆见面。不要提前把信息告诉学习者。: You're busy Sunday morning, free at five in the afternoon and would like to meet at the library. Don't reveal these details to the learner in advance.
双方说清并确认一个共同可行的安排。: Both speakers clearly state and confirm an arrangement that works for them.
确认日期、时区和演示用途: Confirming the date, time zone and purpose of a demonstration
用 this 与 next 明确相对日期，再用完整日期确认：Do you mea: Use “this” and “next” to distinguish relative dates, then confirm the full date: “Do you mean this Friday or next Friday?” Since relative dates can be ambiguous, include the calendar date and time zone in real conversations.
读出并区分：THIS Friday / NEXT Friday；nine in: Read these contrasts aloud: THIS Friday / NEXT Friday; nine in LONDON / five in SHANGHAI. Stress what changes, then use each pair in a complete confirmation sentence.
你是 Andy，收到了两个容易混淆的会议安排，需要逐项核对。: You're Andy. You've received two meeting arrangements that are easy to mix up. Check each one.
问清是哪一个周五以及哪个时区。: Check which Friday and which time zone the speaker means.
复述两个安排，并说明会发送含完整日期的确认。: Repeat both arrangements and say you'll send confirmation with the full dates.
给出可留到的时间，并建议提前安排必要讨论。: Say how late you can stay and suggest holding any essential discussions earlier.
你与国外朋友约一次视频通话。用英语确认日期、双方本地时间和预计时长，最后完整复述: Arrange a video call with a friend abroad. In English, confirm the date, both local times and expected duration. Check an actual calendar and repeat the full arrangement at the end.
用一至两分钟讲清两个会议如何被混淆和纠正。结尾说明为什么测试账号与“不是上线”这: In one to two minutes, explain how the meetings got mixed up and how the confusion was resolved. End by explaining why the invitation needs to specify test accounts and make clear that this is not a launch.
确认邀请、改约时间、说明位置: Confirming an invitation, changing the time and describing a location
There is / There’s 用于说明某地有什么：There’s a s: Use “there is” or “there's” to say what's in a place: “There's a shop near exit two.” Make sentences about two landmarks near you.
区分 SEVEN 和 HALF past SEVEN。说三组时间并录下来听，重点: Distinguish SEVEN from HALF past SEVEN. Say three pairs of times and record yourself. Listen for clarity rather than aiming for a particular speed.
朋友晚到，你已经到了餐厅。: Your friend is running late. You're already at the restaurant.
说你快到了，并问能否先点一点吃的。: Say you're almost there and ask if they can order something to eat first.
用出口和一个地标说明位置。: Describe the location using an exit and one landmark.
用两句真实的话说今天的一件事，别只说 fine。: Share something that actually happened today in two sentences. Go beyond “fine.”
改成看电影前见面：朋友会迟到十五分钟。说明你的位置，并商量是在门口等还是先进去。: Imagine you're meeting before a film and your friend will be fifteen minutes late. Explain where you are and discuss whether to wait at the entrance or go in first.
用 first、then、finally 三个连接词讲清晚餐安排如何改变，控制在: In under a minute, explain how the dinner arrangements changed using “first,” “then” and “finally.”
依据证据作出有限上线决定: Using evidence to decide on a limited rollout
练习被动语态表达程序要求：A restart must be agreed ex: Practise the passive for procedural requirements: “A restart must be agreed explicitly.” Compare “Elena approves the restart” with “The restart is approved by Elena.” Explain why you must retain the “by” phrase when identifying the person responsible matters.
把 We have evidence / from ONE real chang: Read “We have evidence / from ONE real change / not a large sample” three times. Stress “one,” then use the same rhythm in two sentences that qualify the scope of the evidence.
你扮演 Andy，在支持窗口接到 Priya 的电话。保持事实准确并推动下一步。: You're Andy, taking Priya's call during the support window. Keep the facts accurate and move the conversation towards the next step.
确认现象和影响，提出先暂停受影响的电话流程: Confirm what happened and whom it affected. Suggest pausing the affected phone process first.
请工作人员共同核对，明确需要单一记录: Ask staff to cross-check the details together and clarify that they need a single record.
限定观察样本，说明问题处理与后续评审: Specify how small the sample was. Explain how the issue was handled and what review will follow.
用英语做一次九十秒活动试运行汇报：只试过一场、出现签到重复、人工核对恢复。分开说: Give a ninety-second report in English on an event trial. Only one session was tested, check-ins were duplicated, and manual checks restored the process. Separate the facts, the response and what the evidence doesn't yet establish.
不看原文，按准备、启动条件、交接问题、暂停与恢复、评审五步复述。必须说明重复电话: Without reading, retell the story in five stages: preparation, launch conditions, the handover problem, pausing and restarting, and review. Explain why the duplicate calls and earlier duplicate internal test emails were separate faults.
发现未被说出的实际需求: Discovering practical needs that haven't been voiced
练习间接疑问句的陈述语序：We need to understand who d: Practise statement word order in indirect questions: “We need to understand who does the extra work.” Rewrite “What does reception need?” starting with “We need to understand…”
将 Could you take us through / a normal c: Read “Could you take us through / a normal change / starting before anyone opens the software?” in three groups. Stress “normal” and “before,” then join the groups while keeping the tone of a request.
你扮演 Andy，与 Elena 探讨前台工作负担。每轮用两到三句回应。: You're Andy discussing the front desk's workload with Elena. Respond in two or three sentences per turn.
承认担忧，并请对方描述一次实际改课流程: Acknowledge the concern and ask the speaker to walk you through an actual class change.
核对现有联系方法，避免立即承诺新技术: Check how staff currently contact people. Avoid promising new technology straight away.
说明这应影响是否启动，并复述你理解的需求: Explain why this should affect the decision to start, then summarise the need as you understand it.
换成社区图书馆预约项目。用英语开口问出三个关于工作人员实际流程的问题，再用 “W: Switch to a community library booking project. Ask three spoken questions in English about what staff actually do. Summarise their imagined answers starting with “What I'm hearing is…”
脱稿讲两分钟：原方案漏掉什么、Elena 如何指出、Andy 如何改变提问。至少: Speak without a script for two minutes. Explain what the original plan missed, how Elena pointed it out and how Andy changed his questions. Explicitly distinguish sending a message from understanding it.
比较交付方案，提出可讨论的分阶段试点: Comparing delivery options and proposing a phased pilot for discussion
用 What if + 过去式提出试探性建议：What if we starte: Use “What if” with the past tense to make a tentative suggestion: “What if we started with one centre?” Here “started” softens the proposal rather than describing a past event.
练习让建议自然收尾：What if we started / with ONE: Practise finishing a suggestion naturally: “What if we started / with ONE centre?” Pause briefly after “started” and stress “one.” Then say “We need to include / the EXTRA work,” stressing the cost the listener needs to consider.
你是 Andy，向 Daniel 提出单个中心试点，必须同时说明代价与未知信息。: You're Andy proposing a single-centre pilot to Daniel. Explain both the costs and what remains unknown.
比较同时支持多个中心的压力与小范围试点的价值。: Compare the pressure of supporting several centres at once with the value of a small pilot.
承认双流程和记录一致性的成本，不把方案说成没有代价。: Acknowledge the costs of running two processes and keeping records consistent. Be clear about those trade-offs.
说明目前只同意评估，还需客户参与和明确停止条件。: Explain that only an assessment has been agreed so far. Client involvement and explicit stopping conditions are still needed.
你建议团队试用一个新的会议方式。用英语比较“全团队立即采用”“一个小组先试”“暂: Suggest trying a new meeting format. In English, compare adopting it immediately across the team, trialling it with one group and waiting. Give one benefit and cost for each, then ask what you still need to know.
用两分钟向没有读过故事的人解释提案。先说问题，再比较三个方案，最后明确当前决定和: Take two minutes to explain the proposal to someone unfamiliar with the story. State the problem, compare the three options and identify the current decision and what the client must still confirm. Keep the project's pre-launch status clear.
区分意图与影响，协商工作边界: Distinguishing intent from impact and negotiating work boundaries
练习强调句 What I need is...，用于把抱怨转成需求。例：What: Use “What I need is…” to turn a complaint into a request, as in “What I need is a clear decision.” Make and say three sentences about time, information and feedback.
读 I felt / that the choices I’d prepared: Read “I felt / that the choices I'd prepared / weren't being considered.” Pause briefly after “felt” and stress “choices” and “considered.” Keep your volume steady as you express dissatisfaction without talking over anyone.
你扮演 Andy，私下与 Daniel 讨论一次令人不舒服的交流。先描述事实，再: You're Andy discussing an uncomfortable exchange privately with Daniel. Describe the facts, then the impact and what you need.
承认他的意图说明，并解释那句话对你的实际影响: Acknowledge his explanation of his intent and describe how his words actually affected you.
给出明确但有条件的建议: Give a clear recommendation subject to a condition.
说明工作取舍，协商一个真实可交付的安排: Explain the trade-off between tasks and negotiate something you can actually deliver.
准备一次与合租室友讨论噪声的英语对话。使用具体事件、实际影响、可执行请求三个部分: Prepare an English conversation with a flatmate about noise. Describe a specific incident, its actual impact and a practical request without speculating about their character or motives. Rehearse two possible responses aloud.
用两到三分钟复述双方各自压力、Andy 承认的担忧，以及最后的具体约定。加入一个: In two to three minutes, retell the pressures on each person, the concern Andy acknowledged and their final agreement. Identify a point where the exchange could have deteriorated but didn't.
询问归属、表达需要、商量共用空间: Asking who owns something, expressing needs and sharing space
my milk 和 your milk 后面有名词；mine 和 yours 可: “My milk” and “your milk” contain nouns; “mine” and “yours” can stand alone. Say both pairs: “This is my bag. This bag is mine.” “Is this your cup? Is this yours?”
把重点放在物主上：Is this YOURS? / No, it’s MINE。: Stress the owner: “Is this YOURS?” / “No, it's MINE.” Pause after each line as if you were really waiting for an answer.
你在整理厨房，需要先问归属，再表达自己的需要。: You're tidying the kitchen. Ask who owns an item first, then explain what you need.
问这是不是对方的包。: Ask whether the bag belongs to the other person.
说你需要一点空间放食物。: Say you need a little room for your food.
说瓶子放不进去，问能否放冰箱门里。: Explain that the bottle won't fit and ask if you can put it in the fridge door.
换成办公室：桌上有别人的包，你需要用桌子。用三句话问归属、说明需要、请求把包放到: Switch to an office. Someone's bag is on a table you need. In three sentences, ask who owns it, explain your need and ask if the bag can go on a chair.
用四到六句讲清 Andy 买了什么、放在哪里、Maya 需要什么、两人怎样解决。: Use four to six sentences to explain what Andy bought, where he put it, what Maya needed and how they resolved the problem.
区分开发完成和可交付，明确验收范围: Distinguishing completed development from readiness for delivery and defining acceptance criteria
用 but 连接能力与限制：I can connect it, but I ne: Connect an ability and a limitation with “but”: “I can connect it, but I need time to check it.” Say what you can do first, then identify the missing condition instead of giving a bare yes or no.
练习对比重音：The CALENDAR works, but the EMAIL: Practise contrastive stress: “The CALENDAR works, but the EMAIL connection is still outstanding.” Read slowly, then emphasise only the contrasting words, then substitute two tasks from your own work.
你是 Andy，主管以为全部功能完成了。你需要重新说明范围并提出验收标准。: You're Andy. Your manager thinks every feature is complete. Restate the scope and propose acceptance criteria.
说明日历已可用，邮件部分仍未连接。: Explain that the calendar works but email is still disconnected.
给出邮件中的时间和收件人两个检查点。: Identify two things to check in the email: the time and the recipient.
建议保留进行中状态，并安排另一位工程师审查。: Suggest keeping the task marked in progress and scheduling another engineer to review it.
朋友请你安排一次旅行，并问“都准备好了吗？”用英语分别说明已订项目、待确认项目，: A friend asks you to organise a trip and says, “Is everything ready?” Explain in English what's booked, what still needs confirmation and what would count as complete.
先用一句话解释误会，再按“已有结果—缺少检查—共同决定”复述会议。至少使用一个: Explain the misunderstanding in one sentence. Retell the meeting in this order: the existing result, the missing checks and the joint decision. Use both “but” and “until” at least once.
用简短结构讲工作经历: Describing work experience with a simple structure
用一般过去时讲完成的工作：I measured the problem and: Use the simple past for completed work: “I measured the problem and changed part of the system.” Give three sentences covering problem, action and result. Notice “worked,” “changed” and the irregular form “made.”
朗读 The report was slow. / I measured the: Read “The report was slow. / I measured the problem. / We released a smaller version.” Pause half a beat after each sentence. Stress “slow,” “measured” and “smaller,” keeping a steady pace even when nervous.
你扮演 Andy，在模拟面试中讲一个真实的技术问题。: You're Andy in a mock interview, describing a real technical problem.
先说问题，控制在两句内。: Start with the problem in no more than two sentences.
用过去时说自己的两项行动。: Use the past tense to describe two actions you personally took.
说结果，并交代是否还有工作留到以后。: Give the result and mention whether any work was left for later.
换到生活场景：讲一次旅行或购物计划出了问题的经历。用六句话说清问题、你的行动和结: Switch to everyday life. Describe a travel or shopping plan that went wrong. In six sentences, explain the problem, what you did and the result. Everyday words are enough.
不看原文，用一分钟复述面试的一个顺利片段和两个困难点，最后说明 Andy 如何重: Without reading, take one minute to recall one smooth moment and two difficult points in the interview. End with how Andy reorganised his project story.
听懂入职安排，并主动确认自己的任务: Understanding onboarding arrangements and checking your own tasks
现在完成时用于说明截至目前的状态：I haven’t got access ye: Use the present perfect for the situation up to now: “I haven't got access yet.” “Yet” means it hasn't happened so far, not that it never will. Describe another preparation you haven't completed yet.
按意群说：I’m Andy / and I’ll be working / on: Speak in groups: “I'm Andy / and I'll be working / on the booking system.” Pause at each slash and stress “Andy,” “working” and “booking.” Repeat three times, then say it without looking.
你是第一天入职的 Andy。先说明访问问题，再确认工作范围。: You're Andy on your first day at work. Explain the access problem, then clarify the scope of your work.
说明办公室门卡可用，但开发系统权限还没有。: Explain that your office access card works but you still don't have access to the development system.
问清本周要完成什么。: Find out what you're expected to finish this week.
说明两份记录冲突，需要确认依据。: Explain that two records conflict and ask which source to rely on.
你第一次参加社区课程。用英语向接待员确认教室、开始时间，以及需要提前准备的东西；: You're attending a community class for the first time. Ask the receptionist at least three specific questions in English to confirm the room, start time and anything to prepare in advance.
用一至两分钟复述第一天的三个小困难。每次先说问题，再说 Andy 做了什么；最后: Take one to two minutes to retell three small difficulties from the first day. For each, describe the problem before Andy's response. Finish with one question he still had.
道歉、表达边界、提出补救安排: Apologising, setting boundaries and offering a remedy
I’m sorry about + 名词：the noise / the mes: Use “I'm sorry about” with a noun such as “the noise,” “the mess” or “the delay.” Apologise for a real minor problem, then offer one way to put it right.
练习平静说 I need some QUIET tonight，避免把每个词都重: Practise saying “I need some QUIET tonight” calmly, stressing just the key word. Then say “I'm sorry about the NOISE” with clear emphasis.
室友告诉你声音太大。先理解问题，再商量办法。: Your flatmate tells you the noise is too loud. Understand the problem first, then discuss a solution.
为噪声道歉，不急着解释。: Apologise for the noise before trying to explain.
提出和朋友到楼下去。: Offer to go downstairs with your friends.
询问几点算晚，并请对方也提前沟通。: Ask what time counts as late and request advance notice from your flatmate as well.
换成同事在你旁边打电话：你要参加线上面试。用两三句说明你需要安静，并商量一个时间: A colleague is making calls beside you and you have an online interview. Use two or three sentences to explain why you need quiet and negotiate a time window.
先说双方各自需要什么，再讲解决办法。尽量不用 good person / bad: First explain what each person needs, then describe the solution. Try to avoid judging anyone as a “good person” or “bad person.”
礼貌说明问题、请求更换、确认费用: Politely explaining a problem, asking for a replacement and checking the charge
I ordered 表示之前已经点过。用 I ordered… / This i: “I ordered” refers to an order already placed. Use “I ordered… / This is… / Could I have… instead?” to explain the problem in three sentences without worrying about complex tenses.
强调对比：I ordered TEA. This is COFFEE。说清两个名: Stress the contrast: “I ordered TEA. This is COFFEE.” Say the two nouns clearly rather than rushing the sentence.
你点了热茶，服务员送来冰咖啡。: You ordered hot tea but the server brought iced coffee.
礼貌引起注意，说你点的是热茶。: Politely get the server's attention and say that you ordered hot tea.
不指责对方，请求改成茶。: Ask to switch to tea without blaming the server.
询问是否需要付两杯的钱。: Ask whether you have to pay for both drinks.
换成商店：你买蓝色杯子，袋子里却是白色的。用三句请求更换并确认是否额外收费。: Switch to a shop. You bought a blue cup but found a white one in the bag. In three sentences, ask for an exchange and check whether there's an extra charge.
讲述这次点餐误会。包括 Andy 最初想怎么做、后来实际说了什么、结果如何。: Retell the ordering mix-up. Include what Andy initially wanted to do, what he actually said and what happened as a result.
确认问题、展示能力与说明限制: Clarifying a problem, demonstrating ability and explaining limits
用 would 描述假设情境中的做法：I would check availab: Use “would” to describe a hypothetical response: “I would check availability again before confirming.” Keep the verb after “would” in the base form and add a specific condition.
朗读 By conflict, / do you mean TWO bookin: Read “By conflict, / do you mean TWO bookings / for the SAME room and time?” Pause briefly around the key words and stress “two” and “same.” Repeat with another work-related term.
你扮演 Andy，参加一个讨论预订系统的技术面试。: You're Andy in a technical interview discussing a booking system.
先确认 conflict 是指重复预订还是团队意见不一致。: First check whether “conflict” means a double booking or a disagreement within the team.
说明检查步骤和你这样做的原因。: Explain the steps you'd check and why.
询问新员工参与客户沟通时能获得的支持。: Ask what support new hires receive when communicating with clients.
换到跨团队会议：对方说 We need better performance。先: Switch to a cross-team meeting. Someone says “We need better performance.” Ask aloud whether “performance” refers to speed, stability or another measure. Suggest one specific thing you can check.
用一至两分钟复述面试：坦诚说明限制、讲项目、确认歧义、解释忘记的术语、询问支持，: In one to two minutes, retell the interview: acknowledging limitations, describing a project, clarifying ambiguity, explaining a forgotten term, asking about support and the eventual outcome. Keep getting the job distinct from mastering English.
提出有限、具体的帮助请求: Making a specific, limited request for help
用 can 表达可提供的帮助和边界：I can give you twenty: Use “can” to state the help you can offer and its limits: “I can give you twenty minutes tomorrow.” Specify the time and scope, then use “I can't…” to explain the limit.
朗读 I can help / for twenty minutes / tom: Read “I can help / for twenty minutes / tomorrow.” Stress “twenty” and “tomorrow,” using pauses to mark the limits of the offer. Then change the duration to ten minutes.
你扮演 Andy，请忙碌的室友看一小段申请材料。: You're Andy asking a busy flatmate to review a short part of your application.
接受时限，指定最需要帮助的一段。: Accept the time limit and identify the paragraph where you most need help.
准确说明自己的职责，不夸大。: Describe your actual responsibilities accurately without exaggerating.
感谢帮助，并说明剩余部分由自己完成。: Thank your flatmate and explain that you'll finish the rest yourself.
换到工作场景：同事请你今天检查十页材料，但你只有十五分钟。开口提出一个做得到的范: A colleague wants you to check ten pages today, but you have only fifteen minutes. Say how much you can check and when, then explain how the rest could be handled.
用五至六句英语复述：请求、Maya 的时间边界、Andy 删除的夸大表达、职责改: In five or six English sentences, retell the request, Maya's time limit, the exaggeration Andy removed, his revised description of his role and his pre-send check. Finish with one request you'd use yourself.
清晰表达，同时为他人留出空间: Speaking clearly while giving others room to participate
练习让步从句表达有限进步：Although Andy still searche: Use a concessive clause to describe qualified progress: “Although Andy still searches for words, he can take part in difficult discussions.” Use “although” to describe two improvements while acknowledging genuine limitations.
读 I understand what changes. / I’m not c: Read “I understand what changes. / I'm not clear about what has to happen FIRST.” Let the second sentence fall naturally and stress “first.” Record yourself and check whether your specific question is clear.
你扮演 Andy，面对新同事和自己的持续学习需要，表达自然且不过度承担。: You're Andy interacting with a new colleague while continuing to learn yourself. Speak naturally without committing to too much.
允许稍后补充，不逼对方马上表达: Allow them to add something later without pressing them to speak immediately.
提出可用时间，并说明更多时间需要调整任务: Offer the time you have and explain that more time would require rearranging tasks.
明确已理解部分，针对仍不清楚的先后关系提问: State what you understand and ask about the order of the steps that are still unclear.
可选 IELTS 风格口语拓展：用英语回答 “What makes a good: Optional IELTS-style speaking practice: answer “What makes a good colleague?” in English. Give a concrete example and discuss why confidence needn't mean always speaking. Record two minutes and listen only for how well the example supports your point. Don't assign a mock score.
脱稿讲三分钟的全书收尾：从初到合租屋的误解，讲到能提问、表达边界、邀请别人参与；: Without a script, give a three-minute closing account of the book. Trace Andy's progress from misunderstandings in the shared flat to asking questions, setting boundaries and inviting others to participate. End at the dinner table while acknowledging that Andy still needs practice.
清楚介绍自己的工作与能力: Introducing your work and abilities clearly
Use the simple present for your profession and abilities: “I build business systems.” Use “I helped…” for a completed contribution. Keep current skills distinct from past projects and focus on introducing your profession in the simple present.
按意群朗读：I build software / for shops. 重读 b: Read in thought groups: “I build software / for shops.” Stress “build,” “software” and “shops.” Read slowly three times, then describe your profession without looking.
你扮演 Andy，在一个行业交流活动上介绍自己。: You're Andy introducing yourself at an industry networking event.
用一句话介绍专业，不只说目前没有工作。: Introduce your field in one sentence that goes beyond saying you're currently unemployed.
给一个普通人能理解的技术例子。: Give a technical example a non-specialist can understand.
说明下一份工作的方向和一个原因。: Describe the direction you want to take in your next job and give one reason.
换到邻居聚会：用英语向一位不懂技术的人介绍你的工作或一项熟练技能，讲一个具体例子: At a neighbourhood gathering, describe your work or a skill to someone without a technical background. Give a specific example in English. Speak for forty seconds without using stock job-application phrases.
不看原文，用五句英语复述 café 对话：Jo 的问题、Andy 最初的回答、技: Without looking, retell the café conversation in five English sentences: Jo's question, Andy's initial reply, the technical example, his job-search direction and what he did at home.
询问反馈并面对拒绝: Asking for feedback and handling rejection
用 because 连接决定与原因：The role is difficult: Connect a decision and its reason with “because”: “The role is difficult for me because it involves frequent customer calls.” Stick to reasons supported by the feedback instead of guessing anyone's motives.
朗读 Was the example WRONG, / or was my ex: Read “Was the example WRONG, / or was my explanation difficult to FOLLOW?” Pause between the options and stress “wrong” and “follow” to make your request for feedback clear.
你扮演 Andy，收到拒信后与招聘人员沟通。: You're Andy speaking to a recruiter after receiving a rejection.
简短回应，询问是否可以请教一个具体问题。: Respond briefly and ask permission to pose a specific question.
追问是例子不合适还是贡献与结果不清楚。: Ask whether the example was unsuitable or whether your contribution and its result were unclear.
确认改进重点并感谢反馈。: Confirm what to improve and thank the recruiter for the feedback.
换到一次未被采用的工作建议：向负责人提出两个具体的反馈问题。开口练习接受一个不喜: Switch to a workplace suggestion that wasn't adopted. Ask the decision-maker two specific feedback questions. Practise accepting an unwelcome but useful answer without launching into a long defence.
用一分钟复述拒绝理由、两条反馈、Rui 的消息和 Andy 的下一步。区分 Me: In one minute, retell the reason for rejection, two pieces of feedback, Rui's message and Andy's next step. Distinguish Meridian from Northstar and a job listing from a job offer.
回电并核实时间与目的: Returning a call and checking its time and purpose
用 Do you mean A or B? 区分两个可能含义：Do you me: Use “Do you mean A or B?” to distinguish possible meanings: “Do you mean ten fifteen, or a fifteen-minute call?” State both options in full.
对比朗读 ten FIFTEEN 与 a FIFTEEN-minute CALL: Contrast “ten FIFTEEN” with “a FIFTEEN-minute CALL,” then read “at TEN / on THURSDAY.” Use stress to distinguish clock time, duration and date. Record yourself and check.
你扮演 Andy，给招聘人员回电并核实安排。: You're Andy returning a recruiter's call and checking the arrangements.
说明自己的姓名和回电原因。: Give your name and explain why you're calling back.
复述日期、时刻和时长，确认时区。: Repeat the date, time and duration, and check the time zone.
询问是否需要准备材料，然后礼貌结束。: Ask whether you need to prepare anything, then close politely.
换到预约维修：对方说 Friday at four for thirty min: Arrange a repair appointment instead. The other person says “Friday at four for thirty minutes.” Check the time, duration and address aloud, then repeat the arrangement. Use your phone to record yourself playing both roles.
不看原文，按漏接、听留言、回电、核对、等待五步复述。必须准确说出反馈电话的日期、: Without reading, retell five steps: missing the call, listening to the message, calling back, checking details and waiting. Give the feedback call's date, time, time zone and duration accurately.
核对重要信息、表达感受、说明下一步: Checking important information, expressing feelings and explaining next steps
用 will / I’ll 表示此时作出的下一步安排：I’ll read the: Use “will” or “I'll” for a next step you decide on now: “I'll read the letter. I'll update my CV.” Name two small things you can do tomorrow.
长时间表达分组：at the END / of NEXT MONTH。先单独说时: Break up the longer time phrase: “at the END / of NEXT MONTH.” Say it on its own, then use it in a full sentence.
你向朋友说明一个工作变化。可以虚构，不需要提供私人情况。: Tell a friend about a change at work. Feel free to invent it and keep personal details private.
用两句说明你的团队将关闭，你需要找工作。: Use two sentences to say your team will close and you need to find a job.
说两个具体步骤，允许停顿和简单句。: Name two concrete steps. Pauses and simple sentences are fine.
换成课程被取消：说明课程何时结束、你还不知道什么、准备怎样找替代课程。: Switch to a cancelled course. Explain when it ends, what you still don't know and how you'll look for a replacement.
用约一分钟讲这一天。包括发生的事、Andy 的感受、朋友做了什么、他的三个下一步: Take about a minute to describe the day. Include what happened, how Andy felt, what his friend did and his three next steps.
请求重复、确认时间、提出替代安排: Asking for repetition, confirming times and suggesting alternatives
between eight and twelve 是一个时间范围；until n: “Between eight and twelve” gives a time range. “Until nine” means continuing up to nine. Say the ranges eight to twelve and two to four, then make a sentence about your own schedule.
按意群说：I can STAY / until NINE。先清楚表达时间，再把整: Speak in groups: “I can STAY / until NINE.” Focus on making the time clear, then link the sentence without rushing.
你刚搬进公寓，对方想请你等维修人员。先听对方，再用自己的时间回答。: You've just moved into a flat and someone wants you to wait for a repair worker. Listen before answering based on your own availability.
询问具体时间，不要立刻答应。: Ask for the exact time before agreeing.
说明你九点必须离开。: Explain that you must leave at nine.
询问能否改到下午。: Ask whether the visit can move to the afternoon.
改成预约送货：你下午两点到五点在家。先说明能在家的时间，再请求对方确认。: Arrange a delivery instead. You'll be home from two until five in the afternoon. State when you can be there, then ask the other person to confirm.
用四句说清楚：Andy 到哪里、答应什么、有什么困难、最后怎样解决。: Use four sentences to explain where Andy went, what he agreed to, what difficulty he faced and how it was resolved.
承担判断失误，区分事实、修复和后续影响: Taking responsibility for a mistaken judgement and distinguishing facts, fixes and consequences
用 should have + 过去分词表达本可做但未做的事：I should: Use “should have” with a past participle for something you could have done but didn't: “I should have checked the rule.” Follow with what you're doing to fix it now instead of stopping at self-blame.
读：I ASSUMED it / without CHECKING. 不把 wi: Read “I ASSUMED it / without CHECKING.” Articulate “without” clearly. Then read “Only INTERNAL TEST accounts were affected,” stressing the scope so the listener doesn't mistake it for a real customer incident.
你是 Andy，发现内部测试重复发信，需要承担责任并汇报。: You're Andy. Internal tests sent duplicate emails. Take responsibility and report what happened.
说明是自己的逻辑和未经确认的假设导致。: Explain how your own logic and an unchecked assumption caused it.
说明已核查收件人，影响仅限团队内部测试账号。: Say that you've checked the recipients and only the team's internal test accounts were affected.
说明还需独立审查，并提出更新后的检查安排。: Explain that an independent review is still needed and propose a revised checking schedule.
你在工作演示中用了旧数据，但尚未发给外部客户。用英语向同事说明错误、已核实的影响: You used old data in a work demonstration but haven't sent it to external clients. Explain the mistake to a colleague in English. Cover the verified impact, remedy and remaining checks without shifting blame.
用两分钟复述事件，必须区分三件事：最初假设、测试中已发生的影响、尚待完成的审查。: Retell the incident in two minutes. Distinguish the initial assumption, the actual impact during testing and the review still outstanding. Use “should have” to identify one specific mistake.
说明选择、成本与必要条件: Explaining options, costs and necessary conditions
练习条件句中的明确后果：If the readiness checks fail: Practise stating consequences explicitly: “If the readiness checks fail, we will delay the pilot.” Write a recommendation using “provided that” and spell out its key prerequisite.
对比重音：A smaller pilot / on Friday；a delay: Contrast “a smaller pilot / on Friday” with “a delay / with wider preparation.” Read each group three times, using pauses to link each choice to its cost.
你扮演 Andy，向 Daniel 解释排期取舍，不把所有风险混成一个结论。: You're Andy explaining scheduling trade-offs to Daniel. Discuss each risk on its own terms.
承认延期成本，然后提出两个选择: Acknowledge the cost of delay and present two options.
说明真实时间边界和需要另行安排的覆盖: State your actual time limit and explain what coverage needs separate arrangements.
说明它可以等待，并指出真正必要的条件: Explain what can wait and identify the condition that's genuinely necessary.
用英语比较搬家当天的两个方案：当天只搬必需品，或推迟一天全部搬完。说出各自成本、: In English, compare moving only essentials today with delaying a day to move everything. Give each option's cost, one condition that affects the choice and a conditional recommendation.
